------------------------------------------------------------------------
This script obtains the active argos float locations and rasterizes them
------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
library(argoFloats)
library(oce)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(tools)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(rnaturalearth)
```


```{r}
# get the argo float information
indexargo <- getIndex(destdir = tempdir())

argo_sub <- argoFloats::subset(indexargo, 1:2)
```

```{r}
#put the argo floats information into a dataframe
argo_df <- data.frame(float_file = indexargo[["file"]],  obs_date = indexargo[["date"]], date_update = indexargo[["date_update"]], ocean = indexargo[["ocean"]],prof_type = indexargo[["profiler_type"]],  institution = indexargo[["institution"]], lon = indexargo[["longitude"]], lat = indexargo[["latitude"]])

#filter out observations that do not have longitude or latitude, a date, or a profile
argo_df_complete <- argo_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat) , !is.na(lon) , !is.na(float_file), !is.na(obs_date),
  # filter out profiles with incorrect longitude and latitudes
  lon >= (-180) & lon <= 180,  
  lat >= (-90) & lat <= 90)
```

```{r}
#make the points into an sf object
argo_obj <- st_as_sf(argo_df_complete, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)


plot(argo_obj[,1])
```


```{r}
#extract unique float instrument id
argo_df_complete$float_id <- gsub(".*?/(\\d+)/profiles/.*", "\\1", argo_df_complete$float_file)
argo_df_complete$source <- gsub("/.*", "", argo_df_complete$float_file)



```



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Create argo rasters for each year in mollweide for processing and 4326 for plotting purposes
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
#write in out directory 
out_directory <-  "argo/moll/res1/"

## Filter data by year
obs_years <- 2010:2024
argo_df_complete$year <- year(argo_df_complete$obs_date)  # create variable year
argo_df_complete<- filter(argo_df_complete, year %in% obs_years)


#find the number of unique float instrument
length(unique(argo_df_complete$float_id)) #15,774
#number of profiles
nrow(argo_df_complete) #2425873

argo_stack <- c()
#1 degree resolution
argo_mask <- rast(ext(-180, 180, -90, 90), xmin = -180, xmax=180, ymin=-90, ymax =90,crs = "EPSG:4326", resolution = 1)
argo_mask
crs_moll <- st_crs("ESRI:54009")$wkt
#get around same number of rows and columns
argo_mask <- project(argo_mask, crs_moll, method = "near", res = 100000)
argo_mask

for (obs_year in obs_years){
  print(obs_year)
  
  #subset for the specific year
  argo_year_df <<- argo_df_complete %>%
    filter(year == obs_year)
  
  #make data into an sf object
  argo_obj_year <- st_as_sf(argo_year_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
  argo_obj_year <- st_transform(argo_obj_year, crs_moll)

  argo_raster <- rasterize(vect(argo_obj_year), argo_mask, fun="sum", background = 0)
  plot(argo_raster)
  
  argo_stack <- c(argo_stack, argo_raster)
  
  argo_name <- paste0("argo_profile_counts_moll_res1_", obs_year, ".tif")
  out_name <- paste0(out_directory, argo_name)
  print(out_name)

  #add to stack
  writeRaster(argo_raster, out_name, overwrite = TRUE)
}
argo_complete_sf <- st_as_sf(argo_df_complete, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)


```

```{r}
#bring back in where saved argo raster files are located. Change "input path" to your folder.
argo_list <- list.files(path = "input_path", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

argo_stack <- rast(argo_list)
```


```{r}
#create ocean mask
ocean_mask <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "ocean", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")

#load in extent to rasterize 
ocean_mask <- rasterize(vect(ocean_mask), rast("argo_profile_counts_4326_2017.tif"), field = 1)


#reproject to argo floats crs_moll
ocean_mask_moll <- project(ocean_mask, crs(rast(argo_list[[1]])))


```



```{r}

argo_stack <- list.files("Argos/profile_counts", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
argo_stack <- rast(argo_stack)
ocean_mask <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "ocean", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")


plot(ocean_mask)

ocean_mask <- rasterize(vect(ocean_mask), rast("Argos/argo_profile_counts_4326_2007.tif"), field = 1)

crs_moll <- st_crs("ESRI:54009")$wkt

ocean_mask_moll <- project(ocean_mask, crs_moll)
ocean_mask_moll <- crop(ocean_mask_moll,rast(argo_stack[[1]] ))
ocean_mask_moll <- resample(ocean_mask_moll,rast(argo_stack[[1]]), method = "bilinear" )

res_xy <- res(argo_stack[[1]])  # in meters, e.g., c(xres, yres)
cell_area_m2 <- res_xy[1] * res_xy[2]
cell_area_km2 <- cell_area_m2 / 1e6

#create an area raster in meters to find density distribution
area_rast <- rast(argo_stack[[1]])
values(area_rast) <- cell_area_km2


gap_area_list <- list()
undersampled_stack <- rast()

for (i in 1:nlyr(argo_stack)) {
  argo_rast <- argo_stack[[i]]
  argo_rast <- mask(argo_rast, ocean_mask_moll)
  plot(argo_rast)
  
  # Calculate density distribution of profiles per km²
  density_rast <- argo_rast / area_rast
  
  # Get 20th percentile of nonzero values
  vals <- values(density_rast, na.rm = TRUE)
  vals <- vals[vals > 0]
  q20 <- quantile(vals, probs = 0.20, na.rm = TRUE)
  print(paste("Year:", 2010 + i - 1, "q20 =", q20))
  
  # Start with NA raster
  un_under_rast <- density_rast
  values(un_under_rast) <- NA
  
  # 1 = unsampled 
  un_under_rast[density_rast == 0] <- 1
  
  # 2 = undersampled (greater than 0 and ≤ q20)
  un_under_rast[density_rast > 0 & density_rast <= q20] <- 2
  
  # Store in stack
  undersampled_stack <- c(undersampled_stack, un_under_rast)
  
  # Calculate gap areas
  gap_area_unsampled <- global(area_rast * (un_under_rast == 1), sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  gap_area_undersampled <- global(area_rast * (un_under_rast == 2), sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  
  # Save data of un-sampled and under-sampled per year
  gap_freq <- data.frame(
    value = c(1, 2),
    year = 2010 + i - 1,
    area_km2 = c(gap_area_unsampled, gap_area_undersampled)
  )
  
  gap_area_list[[i]] <- gap_freq
}

names(undersampled_stack) <- paste0("year_", 2010:(2010 + nlyr(argo_stack) - 1))



gap_persistence <- app(undersampled_stack, function(x) {
  sum(!is.na(x) & x > 0) / length(x)
})
gap_persistence <- mask(gap_persistence, ocean_mask_moll)
plot(gap_persistence)


gap_persistence_4326 <- project(gap_persistence, 'epsg:4326', method = "near", res = 1)
writeRaster(gap_persistence_4326, "gap_persist_1res_4326.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(gap_persistence, "gap_persist_1res_moll.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
plot(gap_persistence_4326)

# Mask for high persistence (≥80%) across all the years
coldspot_mask <- classify(gap_persistence, matrix(c(-Inf, 0.8, NA, 0.8, Inf, 1), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE), right = FALSE)


coldspot_patches <- patches(coldspot_mask, directions = 4)



# Convert to polygons
coldspot_polygons <- as.polygons(coldspot_mask, dissolve = TRUE)
coldspot_disaggregated <- terra::disagg(coldspot_polygons)


# Calculate area in km²
cold_spot_sf <- st_as_sf(coldspot_disaggregated)
cold_spot_sf$area_sf <- as.numeric(st_area(cold_spot_sf))/1e6


# Filter for spots greater than 200,000 square kilometers
large_coldspots_sf <- cold_spot_sf %>%
  filter(area_sf > 200000)


# Convert back to a raster
final_cold_spot_raster <- rasterize(large_coldspots_sf, gap_persistence)
plot(final_cold_spot_raster, col = "blue")


res_km <- res(final_cold_spot_raster) / 1000  # convert meters to km
cell_area_km2 <- prod(res_km)

#Count the number of coldspot cells 
n_cold_cells <- global(!is.na(final_cold_spot_raster), fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)

#compute total coldspot area
cold_area_km2 <- n_cold_cells * cell_area_km2
cold_area_km2 <- global(final_cold_spot_raster == 1, "sum", na.rm = TRUE) * cell_area_km2

print(cold_area_km2)
print(sum(large_coldspots_sf$area_sf))


#percent of area cold surface area eliminated
print("previous area before filtering")
print( sum(cold_spot_sf$area_sf))
eliminated_area <- 1-(sum(large_coldspots_sf$area_sf)/ sum(cold_spot_sf$area_sf))
print("eliminated area")
print(eliminated_area)
writeRaster(final_cold_spot_raster, "final_coldspot_raster_1resmoll.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
final_cold_spot_raster_4326 <- project(final_cold_spot_raster, 'epsg:4326', res = 1, method = "near")
ocean_mask_4326 <- rasterize(vect(ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "ocean", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")), 
                              final_cold_spot_raster_4326, field = 1)
final_cold_spot_raster_4326 <- mask(final_cold_spot_raster_4326, ocean_mask_4326)
writeRaster(final_cold_spot_raster_4326, "final_coldspot_raster_1res_4326.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
plot(final_cold_spot_raster_4326)

#make gap area dataframe
gap_area_df <- bind_rows(gap_area_list) %>%
  mutate(
    class = factor(value, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Un-sampled", "Under-sampled")),
    area_10k_km2 = area_km2 / 1e4  
  )

write.csv(gap_area_df, "argos_gap_area_df.csv")
```
